reason: The protocol-1.5 run exposed that CanonicalWeather.sky_temperature_c was not copied into the object engine WeatherState. The radiative-boundary solver therefore received solar position and shortwave irradiance but no sky temperature, and skipped its longwave term. Protocol 1.5.1 freezes the missing typed weather handoff before rerun.
unchanged_from_v1_5: distinct SUA supply and EHA exhaust terms
opaque sol-air equation and declared surface properties
all source schedules and physical parameters

corrected_handoff.verification: an end-to-end integration test requires a colder measured sky to cool every Annex 71 airbody relative to a sky at outdoor-air temperature

scientific_label: Results remain post-unsealing corrected diagnostics. Protocol 1.5 v6 is retained as rejected evidence of the incomplete handoff; neither v6 nor this rerun can restore a blind-validation claim.
